title: Train Claude to write like humans actually do #claude #ai #prompt
description:
Learn how to humanize AI writing using simple prompting techniques.

This guide shows you how to train Claude to mirror natural writing patterns by leveraging Wikipedia’s own criteria for detecting synthetic text. Whether you use paid tools or free versions, you will walk away with a practical method to refine your AI-generated drafts.

Try this technique on your next article and let me know if it improves your results in the comments.
